'''Elgar''' was one of four continents on the planet of [[Lazerian IV]].

==Description==
It was located on the planet's western hemisphere.<ref name="LIV" /> The terrain was mostly made up of plains, with forests covering the middle peninsula, while a large mountain range went through the continent from north to south.<ref name="PLTK" /> Together with [[Torm]] and [[Laz]], it made up the [[Kingdom of Devit]].<ref name="LIV" />
